title: Email Nurture + Launch Sequence
body:
# Email Nurture + Launch Sequence — Faceless Digital Assets

## Overview

Full lifecycle sequence: lead magnet delivery → nurture → launch → cart-open urgency → post-purchase. Designed for a faceless digital assets brand (templates, mockups, design packs, fonts, stock assets).

**Send platform assumption:** ConvertKit / Beehiiv / Klaviyo (ESP-agnostic logic)
**Audience:** cold opt-ins from lead magnet; existing subscriber list for launch blast
**Primary KPI:** Revenue per subscriber (RPS); secondary: open rate, click-to-purchase rate

---

## Segment Definitions

| Segment | Criteria | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `new_lead` | Opted in < 7 days | Lead magnet downloaders, cold traffic |
| `warm_subscriber` | Opted in > 7 days, no purchase | Nurtured but unconverted |
| `buyer` | Has purchased any product | Suppress from launch hard-sell; use upsell track |
| `engaged_non_buyer` | Opened 2+ emails, no purchase | Highest-priority launch targets |
| `unengaged` | No open in 30+ days | Suppress or run re-engagement first |

---

## TRACK 1: Lead Magnet Nurture Sequence (New Subscribers)

Trigger: form submission / lead magnet opt-in
Goal: deliver value, establish trust, convert to first purchase within 7 days

---

### Email LM-1 — Lead Magnet Delivery
**Send:** Immediately on opt-in | **Segment:** `new_lead`

**Subject:** Your free [asset name] is here
**Preview text:** Plus: one thing most creators miss when using templates

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

Your free [asset name] is ready — grab it here:

→ [Download Link]

Quick tip while you're setting it up:
[E.g., "Swap the font to match your brand before anything else. It changes the whole feel instantly."]

Over the next few days I'll share how other creators are using assets like these to build income without showing their face online.

Speak soon,
[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Download button | **KPI:** 60%+ open rate, 40%+ click rate

---

### Email LM-2 — Value / Education
**Send:** Day 2 | **Segment:** `new_lead`

**Subject:** The faceless creator model (what actually works)
**Preview text:** No camera. No personal brand. Here's the real playbook

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

Most people think building income online means showing your face and chasing followers.

Faceless creators prove that wrong every month.

Here's the model:
1. Pick a niche (design, productivity, Notion, social media, etc.)
2. Create or curate digital assets that solve a specific problem
3. Sell as digital downloads — no inventory, no shipping, no overhead
4. Let the assets do the talking

The bottleneck is not the idea. It's the assets.

That's exactly why we built [brand/product name] — [one-line value prop].

More on that tomorrow.

— [Brand Name]

**CTA:** None (value-only) | **KPI:** 45%+ open rate

---

### Email LM-3 — Social Proof / Results
**Send:** Day 3 | **Segment:** `new_lead`

**Subject:** "I made my first sale in 48 hours" (here's how)
**Preview text:** Real story. No gatekeeping

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

[Customer pseudonym] downloaded our [product pack] on a Tuesday.

By Thursday, they had their Etsy/Gumroad/Stan store set up and made their first $[X] sale.

No following. No ads. They just started.

[2-3 sentence story with specifics — what asset they used, what store they sold on, what they earned in week one]

Digital assets: the upfront work is done once. After that, recurring income.

If you haven't checked out [product/pack name] yet:

→ [Product Link] — [brief description + price]

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Soft product link | **KPI:** 40%+ open rate, 5%+ click rate

---

### Email LM-4 — Objection Handler
**Send:** Day 5 | **Segment:** `new_lead` (non-purchasers)

**Subject:** "But I'm not a designer..."
**Preview text:** You don't need to be. Here's why

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

The #1 thing I hear: "This looks great but I'm not a designer."

Neither are most of the people making money with these assets.

Everything in [brand name] is built for Canva — drag, drop, change colors, done. No design skills required.

If you get stuck: [support resource or tutorial link].

The assets handle the hard part. You handle the selling.

→ [Shop / Product Link]

P.S. Not sure which pack to start with? Reply and I'll point you in the right direction.

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Shop link + reply CTA | **KPI:** 38%+ open rate, 6%+ click rate

---

### Email LM-5 — Soft Close
**Send:** Day 7 | **Segment:** `new_lead` (non-purchasers)

**Subject:** Last one from me for a while
**Preview text:** Then I'll leave you alone (unless you want more)

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

This is the last email in this intro series.

If the faceless creator model isn't for you right now — no worries. I'll only email when there's something genuinely useful.

But if you've been thinking about it:

→ [Best-selling product or bundle] — [one-line description]

This is the one I'd start with. It's what most new creators use to get their first sales.

Happy to have you here.

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Final product push | **KPI:** 35%+ open rate, 7%+ click rate

---

## TRACK 2: Launch Sequence (New Product / Seasonal)

Trigger: manual send to `warm_subscriber` + `engaged_non_buyer`
Suppressed: `buyer` segment (routed to upsell track)
Goal: convert warm subscribers during 5-day launch window

---

### Email L-1 — Teaser / Early Access
**Send:** T-3 days | **Segment:** all non-buyers

**Subject:** Something new is coming Thursday
**Preview text:** Early access for subscribers only

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

On Thursday we're releasing [product name] — [1 sentence description].

Subscribers get first access before it opens to the public.

I'll send you the link the moment it drops.

→ [Optional: click here to be notified first]

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Early access tag link | **KPI:** 45%+ open rate, 15%+ click rate

---

### Email L-2 — Launch Day Announcement
**Send:** Launch day 9am | **Segment:** all non-buyers

**Subject:** [Product name] is live
**Preview text:** [Quantity/time]-limited — here's everything inside

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

It's here.

[Product name] — [one-line value prop]

Inside:
- [Feature/item 1]
- [Feature/item 2]
- [Feature/item 3]
- [Bonus if applicable]

All [file formats]. Works in Canva / Photoshop / [tool]. Instant download.

Intro price: $[X] (goes to $[Y] after [date/sales threshold])

→ Get [Product Name]

[Brand Name]

P.S. [Urgency line — e.g., "47 people already grabbed it this morning."]

**CTA:** Primary purchase button | **KPI:** 50%+ open rate, 10%+ click rate, 3-5% purchase rate

---

### Email L-3 — Value Deepdive
**Send:** Launch Day +1, 10am | **Segment:** opened L-2, no purchase

**Subject:** What's actually inside [product name]
**Preview text:** Screenshot tour + use cases

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

[Product name] came out yesterday — [X sales / specific reaction].

For those still deciding, here's a closer look:

- "Template 03 — perfect for selling [niche] packs on Etsy. The layout converts."
- "The mockup set — drop your own designs in 60 seconds, looks studio-quality."
- "[Asset 3] — [specific use case]"

All for $[price].

→ [Product Link]

Any questions? Hit reply.

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Product link | **KPI:** 42%+ open rate, 8%+ click rate

---

### Email L-4 — FAQ / Objection Handler
**Send:** Launch Day +2, 11am | **Segment:** non-buyers only

**Subject:** Quick question before you decide
**Preview text:** I want to make sure this is right for you

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

[Product name] is still open. A few questions that came in:

**"Is this for beginners?"** Yes. Everything is drag-and-drop in Canva. No design experience needed.

**"What if I already have templates?"** [Product name] [complement / differentiation line].

**"What platforms can I sell on?"** Etsy, Gumroad, Stan Store, your own site.

**"Is there a refund policy?"** [Your policy here.]

→ [Product Link] — $[Price]

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Product link | **KPI:** 38%+ open rate, 7%+ click rate

---

### Email L-5a — Closing Urgency (Morning)
**Send:** Final day 8am | **Segment:** non-buyers only

**Subject:** Closes tonight at midnight
**Preview text:** Price goes up (or doors close)

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

[Product name] closes tonight at midnight.

After that: [price goes to $Y / goes into the vault / not available until next launch].

- [Bullet 1]
- [Bullet 2]
- [Bullet 3]

$[Price] → [Product Link]

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Direct purchase link | **KPI:** 48%+ open rate, 8%+ click rate

---

### Email L-5b — Final Call (Afternoon)
**Send:** Final day 4pm | **Segment:** non-buyers only

**Subject:** 8 hours left
**Preview text:** Closing at midnight — final reminder

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

Last call — [product name] closes in 8 hours.

→ [Product Link]

That's it. No pitch. Just wanted you to have the link.

[Brand Name]

**CTA:** Direct purchase link | **KPI:** 35%+ open rate
**Combined L-5a + L-5b purchase rate target:** 4%+

---

## TRACK 3: Post-Purchase Onboarding (Buyer Track)

Trigger: purchase tag applied
Goal: activate the asset, reduce refund risk, seed upsell

---

### Email PP-1 — Delivery + Quick Win
**Send:** Immediate on purchase

**Subject:** Your download is ready
**Preview text:** Plus: the fastest way to get your first sale

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

Thank you! Your download is ready:
→ [Download Link]

Quick setup:
1. [Step 1 — e.g., download the zip, open in Canva]
2. [Step 2 — e.g., duplicate to your account]
3. [Step 3 — e.g., customize brand colors + fonts]

Most people have their first listing live within a day. Let me know how it goes — I read every reply.

[Brand Name]

---

### Email PP-2 — Day 3 Check-In + Upsell Seed
**Send:** Day 3 post-purchase

**Subject:** How's [product name] going?
**Preview text:** Quick check-in + one thing to try

**Body:**

Hey [first_name],

Just checking in — have you had a chance to set up [product name] yet?

Quick tip: [specific actionable tip tied to the product].

Also — a lot of buyers pair [product name] with [complementary product] to [outcome]:

→ [Upsell Product Link]

[Brand Name]

---

## Timing Summary

| Code | Track | Send Timing | Segment |
|---|---|---|---|
| LM-1 | Lead Magnet Delivery | Immediate on opt-in | new_lead |
| LM-2 | Nurture / Education | Day 2 | new_lead |
| LM-3 | Social Proof | Day 3 | new_lead |
| LM-4 | Objection Handler | Day 5 | new_lead (no purchase) |
| LM-5 | Soft Close | Day 7 | new_lead (no purchase) |
| L-1 | Teaser | T-3 days | all non-buyers |
| L-2 | Launch Day | Launch day 9am | all non-buyers |
| L-3 | Value Deepdive | +1 day 10am | opened L-2, no purchase |
| L-4 | FAQ/Objection | +2 days 11am | no purchase |
| L-5a | Closing Urgency | Final day 8am | no purchase |
| L-5b | Final Call | Final day 4pm | no purchase |
| PP-1 | Post-Purchase Delivery | Immediate on purchase | buyer |
| PP-2 | Upsell Seed | Day 3 post-purchase | buyer |

---

## KPI Targets

| Metric | Target | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Welcome email open rate | 60%+ | Triggered sends have higher deliverability |
| Nurture avg open rate | 40%+ | Days 2-7 |
| Launch announcement open rate | 50%+ | Launch day send |
| Launch click-to-purchase rate | 3%+ | Per send, non-buyer segment |
| Closing email combined purchase rate | 4%+ | L-5a + L-5b |
| Revenue per subscriber (RPS) | $1.50+ | Per launch window |
| Post-purchase upsell click rate | 8%+ | Day 3 email |
| Unsubscribe rate per send | < 0.5% | Per send |

---

## A/B Test Plan

| Test | Variable | Hypothesis | Lift Target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Subject line style | Curiosity vs. direct benefit (LM-2) | Curiosity drives higher open rate | +5% OR |
| CTA copy | "Get [Product]" vs. "Start Selling Today" | Action-oriented copy lifts CTR | +2% CTR |
| Social proof placement | LM-3 — top vs. bottom | Top placement lifts clicks | +3% CTR |
| Launch send time | 9am vs. 11am (L-2) | Morning outperforms for this niche | +8% OR |
| Urgency type | Price scarcity vs. availability (L-5a) | Test which converts better | +1.5% purchase rate |

---

## Deliverability Notes

- **Sender name:** Keep consistent — changes hurt recognition and deliverability.
- **Plain text:** Always include alongside HTML sends.
- **Suppression:** Buyers MUST be suppressed from launch hard-sell. Apply tag on purchase trigger.
- **Re-engagement:** Sunset unengaged (no open 30+ days) before any launch blast. Remove non-reopeners.
- **Domain warm-up:** If volume exceeds 5,000/day on a new domain, ramp over 2 weeks before launch.
